result.topic_en: Derivation of Riemann's bilinear period relations: integrating w_μ dw_μ' around the boundary of the dissected surface T' gives the relations Σ_ν (A^ν_μ B^ν_μ' − B^ν_μ A^ν_μ') = 0 between the periods of the everywhere-finite integrals, which under normalization become the symmetry a_{μ,μ'} = a_{μ',μ}.
